apps.description: The official documentation covers tooling setup, RPC/REST endpoints, relevant Cosmos SDK modules, and best practices for building on Safrochain. It complements the marketing site and faucet for testnet onboarding.
apps.name: Documentation
apps.shortDescription: Developer reference: guides, API endpoints, and wallet and network integration docs.

apps.description:
Dyma is the task-to-earn platform for Cosmos and the interchain. Contributors complete on-chain and off-chain quests, build portable reputation (DR credentials on Safrochain), and claim rewards straight to their wallet with no custody and no screenshots.

Projects launch campaigns via Dyma Studio with escrowed reward pools, hybrid verification (on-chain indexer, platform APIs, custom REST, manual review), and sybil-resistant reputation floors. Dyma Points (DP) drive seasons and leaderboards; Dima Reputation (DR) compounds into on-chain credentials projects can trust for grants, allowlists, and governance.
apps.name: Dyma
apps.shortDescription: Task-to-earn for Cosmos and the interchain. Verifiable quests, portable reputation, and self-custody rewards.
apps.statusNote: Live on Safrochain testnet at testnet.landing.dyma.io.

apps.description:
EightSaf Wallet is a non-custodial browser extension for Safrochain (Cosmos SDK). Private keys and your 24-word recovery phrase are generated and stored only on your device, encrypted with a spending password. The extension does not operate servers, user accounts, or analytics.

Users can create or restore a wallet, send and receive SAF on Safrochain Testnet, review transaction history, and connect to websites through the EightSaf provider (window.eightsaf) with explicit approval for each connection and signature. A Keplr-compatible API helps Cosmos dApps work without modification.

Install from the Chrome Web Store via eightsaf.io. A Firefox build is packaged separately for AMO submission. Mainnet support is prepared in the wallet and will align with Safrochain mainnet launch.
apps.name: EightSaf Wallet
apps.shortDescription: Non-custodial Chrome extension for Safrochain — send SAF, connect to dApps, and manage your keys locally.
apps.statusNote: Available on Chrome Web Store. Safrochain Testnet supported; mainnet when the network launches.

apps.description:
Ekival is a peer-to-peer trading platform with on-chain escrow. Makers and takers match buy/sell orders; fiat is sent off-chain (mobile money, bank transfer, etc.) while crypto is locked in escrow until both sides confirm remittance and receipt.

The Safrochain deployment uses a CosmWasm port of Ekival's proven Cardano escrow state machine (CreateOrder → TakerCommit → ConfirmRemit → ConfirmReceipt). It powers fiat on-ramp and off-ramp flows for ecosystem apps such as Safrimba savings circles, with dispute resolution and configurable fees.
apps.name: Ekival
apps.shortDescription: P2P escrow for fiat ↔ crypto trades — collateral-backed settlement for mobile money and local payment rails.
apps.statusNote: Live P2P product on Cardano; Safrochain CosmWasm escrow on testnet with mainnet at launch.

apps.description: The testnet explorer lets you track on-chain activity in real time — accounts, delegations, SAF transfers, and Cosmos SDK messages. It is the go-to tool for debugging integrations before mainnet (testnet.safrochain.network).
apps.name: Testnet Explorer
apps.shortDescription: Block explorer: transactions, validators, chain height, and direct links to individual txs.

apps.description: The faucet distributes test tokens so builders and testers can deploy contracts and validate flows without real value at stake. Safrochain.com lists it as a live testnet resource; the exact URL is available in the Developers section or the documentation.
apps.name: Token Faucet
apps.shortDescription: Free test SAF to cover fees on the testnet — a key step in the developer onboarding flow.

apps.description: The Safrochain GitHub organization hosts the public repositories for the chain, tooling, and ecosystem projects. It is the entry point for pull requests, releases, and infrastructure-level code transparency.
apps.name: GitHub — Safrochain Org
apps.shortDescription: Open-source organization: node software, developer tools, and community contributions.

apps.description: The grant program aims to support teams building dApps, infrastructure, and tooling around SAF and Safrochain. It complements the technical roadmap (mainnet, foundation, partnerships).
apps.name: Grant Program
apps.shortDescription: Funding for ecosystem builders and projects — announced as coming soon on the official site.
apps.statusNote: Announced as coming soon; not live yet.

apps.description: The Safrochain IBC Bridge lets you send and receive tokens between Safrochain and the wider Cosmos ecosystem via the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol. A dedicated interface for initiating cross-chain transactions seamlessly.
apps.name: Safrochain IBC Bridge
apps.shortDescription: IBC bridge for transferring tokens between Safrochain and connected Cosmos chains.

apps.description: Keplr is a popular browser extension and mobile app for Cosmos chains. Safrochain lists Keplr as a compatible wallet (testnet live, mainnet coming), making it a gateway for holding and using SAF within the interchain ecosystem.
apps.name: Keplr Wallet
apps.shortDescription: Leading Cosmos wallet — supported for Safrochain testnet as listed on the official website.

apps.description: Mintscan provides an aggregated view of Cosmos chains, useful for tracking accounts, governance proposals, and IBC activity. Safrochain references it as an explorer to watch alongside other community-run explorers.
apps.name: Mintscan
apps.shortDescription: Multi-chain Cosmos explorer — listed among the ecosystem's recommended block explorers.

apps.description:
MoMoTrack Oracle brings Mobile Money (MoMo) transaction verification on-chain for Africa. It is a verification and provenance layer on top of licensed aggregators (PowerPay, Cotanipay, and others) — not a financial intermediary.

Developers integrate the MoMoTrack SDK client-side; successful payments are attested with privacy-preserving proofs, validated by the oracle, and recorded immutably on Safrochain. P2P apps, remittance platforms, tontines, and DeFi protocols get cryptographic payment proof instead of manual reconciliation or screenshot disputes.
apps.name: MoMoTrack
apps.shortDescription: Open-source oracle that attests Mobile Money payments on Safrochain — verifiable receipts without screenshots.
apps.statusNote: Oracle and SDK in development — follow the repo for release announcements.

apps.description: Osmosis is a leading AMM in the Cosmos ecosystem. The Safrochain roadmap includes an Osmosis integration (liquidity pools, IBC) to connect SAF liquidity to the broader interchain.
apps.name: Osmosis (IBC)
apps.shortDescription: Cross-chain liquidity and pools — Osmosis integration announced on the Safrochain roadmap.
apps.statusNote: Listed on the roadmap; not live yet.

apps.description:
Pesaex (PesaX) is payment infrastructure built on Safrochain — the real-world money on/off ramp for the ecosystem.

It bridges crypto and Mobile Money across Africa, allowing users to convert Mobile Money to USDC (on-ramp), USDC to Mobile Money (off-ramp), and send value across borders (e.g. Kenya ↔ Nigeria) more cheaply and quickly than traditional rails.

Built on Safrochain with USDC from Noble via IBC. Initial focus: Kenya and Nigeria. Goal: make fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat transfers cheaper, faster, and more accessible.
apps.name: Pesaex
apps.shortDescription: Crypto ↔ Mobile Money bridge for Africa — USDC on/off-ramps and cross-border transfers on Safrochain.

apps.description:
Safhandle is the human-readable identity layer for Safrochain. Resolve short names and phone links like `john` or `+243899123456` to `addr_safro` addresses instead of pasting long bech32 strings.

Built on CosmWasm registry contracts with shared validation for wallets and dApps. Live on mainnet and testnet at handle.safrochain.com.
apps.name: Safhandle
apps.shortDescription: Short names and phone numbers resolve to Safrochain wallet addresses. The human-readable identity layer.
apps.statusNote: Live on Safrochain mainnet and testnet.

apps.description: Safrimba demonstrates CosmWasm usage on Safrochain: rotating savings groups with automated contribution and distribution rules. The official website highlights it in the FAQ and roadmap (beta) as a flagship product for financial inclusion.
apps.name: Safrimba
apps.shortDescription: On-chain digital tontines via CosmWasm — transparent rotating savings groups.
apps.statusNote: Listed as upcoming on official sources; not live yet.

apps.description: Safrochain Hub Mobile App is the official mobile wallet for the Safrochain ecosystem. Send and receive SAF, swap SAF/USDC, bridge assets across Safrochain, Osmosis, and Noble, stake with validators, and explore ecosystem dApps — all from your phone with WalletConnect signing.
apps.name: Safrochain Hub Mobile App
apps.shortDescription: Official Safrochain mobile wallet — swap, bridge, stake, and manage SAF on iOS and Android.

apps.description: The SafroID vision covers username, avatar, bio, and verifiable social links, with planned integration into Safrochain applications. It addresses the need for portable identity mentioned on the website and in the hub docs, distinct from a bare wallet address.
apps.name: SafroID (Vision)
apps.shortDescription: Decentralized identity (DID) and unified profile — described in the ecosystem product documentation.
apps.statusNote: Vision stage — roadmap item, not live yet.

apps.description: SGOV is the dedicated governance platform for Safrochain, enabling SAF token holders to submit proposals, vote on-chain, and participate in the direction of the network and ecosystem. Designed to bring transparent, community-driven decision-making to every aspect of the protocol.
apps.name: SGOV
apps.shortDescription: Governance platform for the Safrochain ecosystem — proposals, voting, and community decision-making.
apps.statusNote: To be determined — governance platform under design.

apps.description:
SMultisig is a non-custodial threshold multisignature wallet for teams, DAOs, and treasuries on Safrochain. Configure any K-of-N quorum with Cosmos SDK LegacyAmino multisig, compatible with Keplr, Leap, and Cosmostation.

Draft transactions off-chain with titles, memos, and fees; each signer approves the same SignDoc in their wallet. Simulate before broadcast, collect partial signatures, and submit when the threshold is met. The app coordinates drafts, roles, and metadata in a private collaboration layer — wallets hold the only private keys.

Supports native SAF, IBC tokens, and Token Factory denoms with auto-resolved symbols and icons. Sign in with ADR-036 wallet auth, role-based access for managers/signers/viewers, SignDoc verification, and encrypted multisig backups for recovery.
apps.name: SMultisig
apps.shortDescription: Non-custodial K-of-N threshold multisig for Safrochain teams — queue, sign, simulate, and execute treasury transactions.
apps.statusNote: Available on Safrochain testnet and mainnet (https://smultisig.safrochain.com).

apps.description: Valopers Mainnet Explorer, powered by Bitszn, tracks Safrochain mainnet activity in real time, including accounts, delegations, SAF transfers, validators, and Cosmos SDK messages.
apps.name: Valopers Mainnet Explorer
apps.shortDescription: Mainnet block explorer powered by Bitszn for transactions, validators, chain height, and direct links to individual txs.

apps.description: Valopers Testnet Explorer, powered by Bitszn, tracks Safrochain testnet activity in real time, including accounts, delegations, SAF transfers, validators, and Cosmos SDK messages.
apps.name: Valopers Testnet Explorer
apps.shortDescription: Testnet block explorer powered by Bitszn for transactions, validators, chain height, and direct links to individual txs.

apps.description:
WinSaf is a non-custodial, provably-fair lottery delivered as a Telegram Mini App on Safrochain. Users open the bot, set a PIN to create a 2-of-3 MPC wallet, fund it with SAF, and buy tickets in one tap with no seed phrase or browser extension required.

Draws run on-chain via an open-source CosmWasm contract with verifiable randomness from the public drand beacon. Prize tiers, jackpot rollovers, and a Must Be Won rule are enforced in contract logic. Players can verify every round on the Safrochain explorer.

The product includes referral rewards, daily missions, achievements, responsible-play limits, and English/French UI. CosmWasm contracts are Apache-2.0 on GitHub; ticket sales and prize claims settle in SAF.
apps.name: WinSaf
apps.shortDescription: Provably-fair on-chain lottery in Telegram with a non-custodial MPC wallet, CosmWasm draws, and SAF prizes.
apps.statusNote: Live on Safrochain mainnet and testnet via Telegram Mini App.
